commit_message:
[VMVX] Prioritize dynamic loops in default distribution

Include omitted dynamic partitionable loops when selecting distribution
tiles, replacing the smallest selected static extent to keep larger static
dimensions tiled. This avoids leaving the dynamic batch of the #25116
convolution reproducer in a temporary spanning its generic upper bound.

Preserve the static-shape policy and already-distributed operations. Add
regressions for outer dynamic dimensions, retained dynamic loops, static
dimension selection, and unchanged static shapes.

Fixes #25116

Assisted-by: Codex
